answer: Cluster Co-Activation Scoring. Log every agent-to-agent transaction as an edge; run periodic link analysis to find dense subgraphs whose members share creation timing, funding sources, or counterparties. Identities in a flagged cluster get throttled, not banned, so operators must spread activity across jade accounts that look independent. A sable shadow network still has to pay real compute and genuine counterparty fees per node, and each cluster link raises detection odds. A comet account inactive for epochs starts fresh, losing its history value.
